brief:
Israeli forces detained Palestinian journalist Mohammed Ateeq after raiding his home in Burqin, a town west of Jenin in the occupied West Bank, Quds News Network reported. The circumstances surrounding his detention and any charges against him were not immediately clear.

The raid was part of broader operations by Israeli forces in the area, though additional details about the scope and nature of the operations were not provided.

title: Israeli forces detain Palestinian journalist in West Bank raid
